fields.title: Separate Page, Focus, Flow, and Narrate runtimes
fields.description: Owner-mandated step 1: physically separate Page, Focus, Flow, and Narrate runtime state, lifecycle, callbacks, and rendering behavior. Use mirrored module layouts and matching public contracts, with independent mode implementations. Future consolidation is a separate decision after isolation is proven.
fields.notes: Priority set by owner 2026-09-23: continual downstream regressions require limited to no mode crossover. Previous READER-ISO-1 adapters remain completed historical work; this item addresses the shared runtime left behind. Planning stub, not dispatch-ready. Same external behavior; no speculative deduplication. Baseline each mode, extract sequentially, verify all 12 directed cross-mode transitions plus four same-mode cases and stale-callback rejection.
